mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_residence (applicant_id, in_china, country, city, address, china_education_level, china_school, visa_type, visa_expiry_date, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{inChina}, #{country}, #{city}, #{address}, #{chinaEducationLevel}, #{chinaSchool}, #{visaType}, #{visaExpiryDate}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_residence set in_china = #{inChina}, country = #{country}, city = #{city}, address = #{address}, china_education_level = #{chinaEducationLevel}, china_school = #{chinaSchool}, visa_type = #{visaType}, visa_expiry_date = #{visaExpiryDate}, update_time = now() where applicant_id = #{applicantId}
